title: Highlight temporarily closed trails
goal: Adds a light yellow background to closure announcements so that readers can quickly find the affected road sections.
summary: background-color fills the background area of the element with color, and the color filling will also cover the area where the padding is located.
tasks: Set the background color of the two closure announcements with closure class to #fff1c2.
Keep the background of ordinary open announcements and the text color of each announcement.

example.note: The reservation confirmation card for the shared kitchen can be marked with a light green background.

hint: When the background does not change but the text changes color, check whether color is written. Use background-color to color the announcement background.
